new_results.statement: In the exact zero-triple-currency finite-leak latent normal form H=D+UCU^T with U_I=[u,0], U_J=[v,w], det C!=0 and |supp(w)|<=2: if alpha=C_11 is nonzero, H is diagonal plus global rank one plus at most one literal physical edge; if alpha=0, support one is diagonal plus one physical star and support two is a two-hub arrowhead with diagonal leaves and rank-one slope.

After a literal outer square Q=a(X0+h)^2+R, if R has diagonal-plus-star quadratic coefficient with slope b and max b_i^2/||b||^2<=1/2, then H_1/2(R)<=8||b||^-1/2 and ||p_Q||_infinity<=8|a|^-1/2||b||^-1/2.
